The assessed exact all-modulus fiber classification additionally specifies the all-level p=2 and p=3 branches and singular odd-prime corrections, not stated or implied in accessible primary full text. A 1991 Dickson Galois-ring paper is inaccessible beyond its abstract and is a recorded partial-priority risk, particularly for p>=5; the full integer-valued small-prime theorem requires separate analysis.

The finite-field image count is a known Dickson-polynomial specialization and is not separately new.
An unlocated older exact tetrahedral residue-multiplicity classification may exist.
No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.

value.rationale: This completes the natural tetrahedral residue and multiplicity invariant for every modulus, beyond merely naming attained classes or computing periods. The five-to-one dyadic exception, three-to-one ternary balance, and exact singular quadratic lifts are structural; the product formula applies directly to congruence obstructions in figurate-number problems.
